environment.description: Application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB). The ALB has an associated AWS WAFv2 Web ACL with the following rule groups evaluated in order: (1) AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with default action, (2) AWSManagedRulesKnownBadInputsRuleSet with default action, (3) a custom rule group 'corp-sqli-deep-inspection' with priority 1 that uses a RegexPatternSet matching UNION/SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE/DROP/semicolons/comment-sequences in query string parameters with action BLOCK and TextTransformation of URL_DECODE followed by LOWERCASE. Additionally, the RDS instance uses the pgaudit extension with pgaudit.log='all' and has a custom PostgreSQL configuration parameter: the database user 'app_readonly' connects through RDS Proxy with IAM authentication, and the user has been granted a restricted role created via: CREATE ROLE readonly_filtered; GRANT SELECT(id, name, email, role) ON users TO readonly_filtered; GRANT readonly_filtered TO app_readonly; — meaning the api_key column is not accessible to this database user regardless of query construction. The RDS Proxy enforces connection pinning with max 10 connections and session-level statement timeout of 3000ms.

config.load_balancer: AWS ALB with WAFv2 Web ACL
waf_rules: Custom rule group 'corp-sqli-deep-inspection': RegexPatternSet on QueryString with URL_DECODE+LOWERCASE transforms, blocks UNION|SELECT|INSERT|UPDATE|DELETE|DROP|--|;|/\*
config.compute: ECS Fargate, task role with no RDS direct access
config.database: RDS PostgreSQL 14 via RDS Proxy, IAM auth
config.db_user_grants: GRANT SELECT(id, name, email, role) ON users TO app_readonly (NO api_key column grant)
config.network: Private subnet, ALB in public subnet, no direct DB access from internet
